name: CAMELYON16: Cancer Metastases in Lymph Nodes Challenge 2016
description: CAMELYON16 is a landmark digital pathology benchmark for automated detection of metastases in whole-slide histopathology images (WSIs) of breast cancer sentinel lymph node sections. Organized by Radboud University Medical Center and University Medical Center Utrecht in conjunction with ISBI 2016, the dataset contains 400 gigapixel WSIs (270 training slides including 110 with nodal metastases and 160 normal slides, plus 130 test slides). Metastatic regions are delineated with detailed pixel-level ground-truth annotations by expert pathologists, establishing the gold standard for clinical-grade lymph node metastasis detection and whole-slide evaluation algorithms.
